## ♿ Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate elements (button, nav, etc.).
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Added `aria-label` to icon-only buttons.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Usable via Tab and Enter keys.
- [ ] **Focus States**: Interactive elements have visible focus.
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Text/icons meet WCAG AA standards.
- [ ] **Alt Text**: Images have descriptive alt text.
